messages:
Ben: Quick sync — pricing/packaging implementation. Need clear owners for these dependencies: metering ingestion -> billing pipeline, quota enforcement, contract clause mapping. Can owners ack? Target: owners confirmed by EOD Friday.
Michelle: Ack — I will own metering ingestion (ETL + event schema). Will coordinate schema with Carlos for billing mapping. @Carlos please confirm you can take the billing pipeline work.
Carlos: Yep, I'll take billing pipeline ownership. Need Michelle's event schema by Wed so I can map into invoice gen. FYI billing team will need the rounding rule and retention fields from contracts.
Ben: The rounding/retention rules live in CON-212. @Sam (contracts) can you confirm rounding policy and retention TTL? Also we need a small contract mapping matrix for enterprise vs consumer.
Sam: On it — I'll review CON-212 today. Quick callouts: invoices retention = 7 years for enterprise, 3 years for consumer; rounding uses bankers rounding to cents. I'll post a contract->billing matrix in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
Alicia: I'll own quota enforcement. Two quick questions for the group: 1) Do we perform hard quota rejection at the gateway or at route-level? 2) How should grace periods and enterprise overrides behave? cc @Dana (infra/ops)
Dana: Gateway-level rejection preferred to reduce wasted compute, but we need a fallback if cache is stale. I'll add a circuit-breaker pattern to the gateway so stale cache doesn't catastrophically block traffic. I'll open a PR for the fallback logic (PR #7890).
Michelle: Schema proposal (minimal fields) — event must include plan_id, contract_id, usage_value and rounded_cost_cents. Example payload:
```
{
  "event_id": "evt_123",
  "plan_id": "enterprise_v2",
  "contract_id": "CON-212",
  "usage_value": 12345.678,
  "rounded_cost_cents": 1234567
}
```
Carlos: For billing mapping: confirm rounding to cents -> multiply by 100, apply banker's rounding. Also we should add `billing_region` to events for regional tax rules.
Sam: Banker's rounding is fine. I'll check if any contract exceptions exist (legacy enterprise deals that round per-invoice not per-usage) and flag them in CON-2144.
Ben: Summarizing dependencies and owners so we can track:
- Metering ingestion (Michelle) -> delivers event schema to billing by Wed
- Billing pipeline & invoice gen (Carlos) -> needs schema, rounding/retention mapping
- Quota enforcement (Alicia) -> gateway + fallback implemented by Dana
- Contracts signoff & matrix (Sam) -> posts mapping + exceptions
Milestone: owners + initial PRs opened by EOD Friday. If someone cannot meet that, say so now and we'll reassign.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled DB maintenance window Thu 23:00 UTC may affect billing DB migrations. Please avoid heavy schema changes then.
Dana: Noted. I'll request a dedicated migration slot Fri 02:00 UTC for billing schema. I'll ping infra-oncall and update the calendar.
Michelle: I'll open PR #4567 tonight with the event schema + sample fixtures and link to this thread.
Ben: Great — thank you everyone. Post any blockers here. :thumbsup:
